Stylish One-Bedroom Apartment in Birmingham City Centre

 A beautifully presented one-bedroom apartment situated within the highly sought-after Orion development, right in the heart of Birmingham City Centre.

 Located on an end plot, the apartment enjoys an excellent amount of natural light and offers spacious, well-proportioned accommodation throughout.

 The property features a bright and welcoming open-plan living and dining area, complemented by a modern fitted kitchen with integrated appliances. The generously sized double bedroom benefits from fitted storage, with a contemporary bathroom.

 Offered fully furnished, this apartment is ready for immediate occupation and provides stylish, comfortable and convenient city-centre living — ideal for a professional individual or couple.
